in_arabic.name: عظيمة

in_urdu.name: عظیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: عظیمہ کا مطلب ہے بہت بڑی یا اہم
in_urdu.long_meaning: عظیمہ نام عربی جڑ 'عظم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بڑا یا عظیم۔ یہ نام عظمت اور بڑائی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اکثر اہم یا بااثر شخصیات کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام رفعت اور شرافت کا بھی اشارہ دیتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں یہ نام خاصی تقدیر اور خوبی کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़ीमा
in_hindi.meaning: अज़ीमा का अर्थ है बहुत बड़ी या महत्वपूर्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीमा नाम अरबी मूल 'अज़म' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बड़ा या महान। यह नाम महानता और महत्व को दर्शाता है, और अक्सर महत्वपूर्ण या प्रभावशाली व्यक्तित्वों का वर्णन करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम उच्चता और सम्मान की भावना भी पैदा करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम विशेष महत्व और सुंदरता के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عظیمہ
in_pashto.meaning: عظیمہ معنی یې لوی یا ډیر مهم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عظیمہ نوم د عربی جڑ 'عظم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لوی یا عظیم دی. دا نوم عظمت او لویۍ څرګندوي، او ډیری وختونه مهمو یا با نفوذه کسانو ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم د لوړتیا او شرافت احساس هم ورکوي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې دا نوم د ځانګړي تقدیر او ښایست سره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Aazimat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aazimat is derived from the Arabic root 'azm', which means great or large. It signifies greatness, grandeur, and high importance. In Islamic tradition, this name is often associated with individuals of significant influence or stature. The etymology of Aazimat can be traced back to Quranic Arabic, reflecting a sense of majesty and nobility. Historically, names like Aazimat have been used to honor individuals with remarkable qualities or achievements. Today, the name Aazimat continues to be used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing respect, admiration, and high esteem.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aazimat" is derived from the Arabic language and holds cultural significance in Islamic traditions. It is a rare and evocative name that signifies the concept of divine forgiveness and redemption. The name carries with it the idea of a fresh start, a new beginning, and the opportunity to make amends for past mistakes. It is a name that resonates with the aspirations of those seeking to purge themselves of past wrongs and beg for pardon from God. In Islamic culture, the value of forgiveness is deeply embedded, as evidenced by numerous traditions and stories in the Quran and Hadiths.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aazimat" conveys a sense of profound humility and deep reverence for the divine mercy and compassionate nature of Allah. The name reminds us of the power and greatness of God, who forgives even the most grievous sins when asked with sincere repentance. It also serves as a reminder to strive for self-improvement and spiritual growth, and to seek forgiveness and absolution from the Almighty. By invoking the name of Aazimat, one can draw spiritual strength and inspiration from the eternal promise of God's mercy and forgiveness. The name Aazimat thus embodies the deeply held Islamic belief in the power of divine forgiveness and the importance of seeking it with sincere devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Heavenly Forgiveness" symbolizes One who is given divine forgiveness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aazimat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of heavenly forgiveness.
